_comment: Intentional deltas for the Board P 20 V / 5 A revision (decisions.json dec-p-20v-revision and dec-p-20v-front-end-r2; user decision card 2026-10-31 D3-A + D5-1). r2 adds the Q3 reverse-blocking FET and Q4 B_GATE pulldown, sets UVLO to 11.5k/4.02k and drops C4. The Q1 proposal (dec-p-20v-q1-5a) replaces the SOT-23 AO3401A with the PowerDI3333-8 DMP3036SFG-7, renumbering gate 1->4 and drain 3->5-9. The frozen routed-module baseline is not rewritten; the PCB still matches the baseline. check_baseline.py checks every declared delta still holds. Phase 6 draft dec-p-20v-q1-gate-clamp adds D8 (BZT52C11-7-F, cathode VBUS_P, anode Q1_G) and changes R12 to 4.7k (value only). Phase 7 draft dec-p-20v-q1-soft-start adds the Q1 Miller network (C36 1 uF VBUS_OUT to Q1_MX, Q5 BSS138 body diode Q1_MX to Q1_G, R27 150k VBUS_P to Q1_MX) and splits VBUS_VS_DISCH into R14 + R28 2 x 470R in series through VBUS_DISCH_R. Phase 7b front end r3 (dec-p-20v-front-end-r3, user decision 2026-10-31) replaces TPS26630 + Q4 with TPS16630PWPR (HTSSOP-20, GND 9 and PAD 21) and LM74700 U3 driving Q3 (EF_GATE, EF_VCAP with C37 to VBUS_IN). The common controller block straps RESET to GND through R21 0R (J2.4 no longer RESET) and removes the R15/R16 I2C pull-ups to VREG_2V7. Phase 9 dec-p-stusb-local-clamp feeds the STUSB4500 high-voltage pins from local small-current clamps: VDD through R29/R30 (VDD_MID) into VDD_LOC with D9 BZT52C18-7-F and C38; VBUS_VS_DISCH gains D10 BZT52C20-7-F; DISCH gains D12 BZT52C18-7-F behind R13 4.7k; VBEN splits into VBEN_PIN (U1.16, J3.8, D11) and VBEN behind the Q6 BSS138 cascode with gate bias VG_LOC from R31/R32. Phase 11 dec-p-q1-gate-clamp-redundant adds D13 (BZT52C11-7-F) in parallel with D8.
